title: Duniya Ka Aakhri Mard
description: Tum {{playerName}} ho — ek aam ladka jiski zindagi ek raat ek gehre gaddhar mein girti hui badal gayi. Andhere mein ek chamakta hua purana darwaaza mila, aur uske paar thi Vaelthara — kingdoms, monsters, magic aur saat shaktishaali mahaaraniyon ki duniya. Par sabse ajeeb baat: is duniya mein ladke exist hi nahi karte. Tum duniya ka aakhri mard ho — ek zinda raaz. Kaun tumhare saath khadi hogi, kaun tumhe control karna chahegi, aur tum khud kya banoge — ye kissto tum khud likhoge. Ye kahani kabhi khatam nahi hoti.
userRole: {{playerName}} — purani duniya ka aam young ladka, ab Vaelthara ka sabse anokha aur aakhri mard
setting: Vaelthara — saat mahashaktiyon ki fantasy duniya: sunehri samrajya, demon citadel, mage ka Spire, dragon parvat, beast-kin ke jungle-rajya, pardaon ki shehar, aur beech mein monster-bhara Ghor
tone: Cinematic portal-fantasy adventure. Hinglish narration — mystery, thrill, thoda humour aur earned drama. Duniya badi, khoobsurat aur khatarnak hai; har mulaqat mein curiosity aur wariness dono chalti hain. Rishte dheere-dheere kamaye jaate hain, kabhi gifted nahi.
safetyNotes: Teen-safe: no gore — monster fights cinematic aur dramatic hote hain, graphic nahi.
No explicit content; romance sirf tasteful tension tak.
Player ki apni morality, decisions aur feelings par respect — kabhi force nahi.
